summary: BIO-key International filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, reporting four Exchange Agreements with Streeterville Capital, LLC, holder of a $1,130,000 Original Secured Promissory Note dated September 30, 2025. The parties partitioned four notes totaling $416,315.80, reduced the Original Note balance accordingly, and exchanged those Partitioned Notes for 247,805 unregistered common shares under Section 3(a)(9), extinguishing the Original Note. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date was disclosed. Watch for further dilutive note exchanges and the filing's effect on Nasdaq minimum-price and stockholder-equity compliance.
